newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Oct internal aluminium sales up 26.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Oct internal aluminium sales up 26.4 pct.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 18,200 tonnes in October, up 26.4 percent from the 14,400 tonnes sold in October 1995, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
Growth in the automobile and electronic sectors helped contribute to the rise, ABAL said.

Another factor was strong performance in the extrusion industry which is expecting to see heavy demand from the civil construction sector in 1997, especially given recent financing announced for home-buyers.
The October figure was little changed from September sales of 18,400 tonnes, which registered a 41.5 percent rise on the corresponding month in 1995.
Total sales in the first ten months of 1996 were 164,900 tonnes, an overall rise of 0.9 percent on the 163,500 tonnes sold in January/October 1995.
Internal sales are expected to rise 2.8 percent to 196,000 tonnes in 1996, ABAL said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
